title: Examining the influence of mobile wallet adoption on behavioural intention and customer satisfaction in Nepal
keywords: unified theory of acceptance and use of technology (UTAUT)
core_idea: Develop and test a TAM/UTAUT-based model that incorporates perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness, social influence, perceived security, and price value to explore the factors shaping mobile wallet adoption, behavioural intention, and customer satisfaction in Nepal's social and economic context.
tldr: Builds and tests a theoretical model (TAM/UTAUT) to identify determinants of mobile wallet adoption, user intention, and satisfaction in Nepal using primary survey data and structural equation modeling.
